title: Build a SOAR Triage Playbook with Shuffle
description: Build an automated phishing triage playbook using Shuffle (free, open-source SOAR). The playbook automatically enriches indicators, quarantines emails, creates tickets, and notifies the analyst.
objective: Students will build and test a working SOAR playbook that automates the first 5 minutes of phishing incident response — the most common task an L1 SOC analyst performs.

steps.title: Set Up Shuffle SOAR
steps.instructions:
**Option A — Cloud (fastest):**
Register at https://shuffler.io/ — free tier available

**Option B — Self-hosted (Docker):**
```bash
git clone https://github.com/Shuffle/Shuffle
cd Shuffle
docker-compose up -d
# Access at http://localhost:3001
# Default: admin@example.com / password
```

Once logged in:
1. Click **Workflows** in the left sidebar
2. Click **+ New Workflow**
3. Name it: `Phishing Triage Playbook`
4. Click the canvas to open the workflow editor

You'll build the playbook by dragging and connecting 'apps' (nodes) on the canvas.

steps.title: Add a Webhook Trigger
steps.instructions:
A webhook is how your SIEM or email gateway will send alerts to Shuffle.

1. In the workflow editor, click **+ Trigger**
2. Select **Webhook** from the trigger list
3. Name it: `SIEM Phishing Alert`
4. Click the webhook node → copy the **Webhook URL**

This URL is what your SIEM would POST to when a phishing alert fires.

**Test the webhook manually** using curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://shuffler.io/api/v1/hooks/webhook_YOUR_ID \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "alert_name": "Phishing Email Detected",
    "sender_ip": "45.33.32.156",
    "sender_email": "attacker@evil-domain.com",
    "subject": "Urgent: Verify your account",
    "recipient": "employee@company.com"
  }'
```

Verify in Shuffle that the execution appeared in the **Runs** tab.

steps.title: Add IP Reputation Check (AbuseIPDB)
steps.instructions:
Add an automatic check of the sender's IP reputation:

1. Search for **HTTP** app in the left panel → drag to canvas
2. Connect: Webhook → HTTP node
3. Configure the HTTP node:
   - URL: `https://api.abuseipdb.com/api/v2/check?ipAddress=$exec.sender_ip&maxAgeInDays=90`
   - Method: GET
   - Headers: `Key=0` → `Key: apiKey`, `Value: YOUR_ABUSEIPDB_KEY`

**Get a free API key:** https://www.abuseipdb.com/register

4. Name this node: `Check IP Reputation`

The response JSON will include:
```json
{"data": {"abuseConfidenceScore": 85, "countryCode": "RU", "totalReports": 42}}
```

Add a **Condition** node after:
- IF `$check_ip.data.abuseConfidenceScore > 50` → HIGH RISK path
- ELSE → INVESTIGATE path

steps.title: Add Alert Creation and Notification
steps.instructions:
**Add a ticket/notification step:**

1. Drag another **HTTP** node to the HIGH RISK path
2. This will simulate creating a ticket (or use a real integration like Jira or TheHive)
3. Configure:
   - URL: `https://webhook.site/YOUR_TEST_URL` (get a free test endpoint at webhook.site)
   - Method: POST
   - Body (JSON):
```json
{
  "title": "HIGH RISK Phishing Detected",
  "severity": "HIGH",
  "sender_email": "$exec.sender_email",
  "sender_ip": "$exec.sender_ip",
  "ip_score": "$check_ip.data.abuseConfidenceScore",
  "action_taken": "IP flagged, analyst notified",
  "analyst": "SOC Team"
}
```

4. Name it: `Create High Risk Ticket`

**For the INVESTIGATE path (score < 50):**
Add another HTTP node sending to the same webhook.site but with severity: `MEDIUM`

Name the whole workflow clearly with node labels.

steps.title: Test the Full Playbook End-to-End
steps.instructions:
Run your playbook end-to-end with two test cases:

**Test 1 — High Risk IP (known malicious):**
```bash
curl -X POST [YOUR_WEBHOOK_URL] \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "sender_ip": "45.33.32.156",
    "sender_email": "attacker@evil.com",
    "subject": "Your account has been compromised"
  }'
```
Verify: Shuffle shows a HIGH RISK ticket was created

**Test 2 — Low Risk IP:**
```bash
curl -X POST [YOUR_WEBHOOK_URL] \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "sender_ip": "8.8.8.8",
    "sender_email": "info@google.com",
    "subject": "Newsletter"
  }'
```
Verify: Shuffle shows a MEDIUM/INVESTIGATE ticket was created

**Document:**
- Screenshot of your Shuffle workflow canvas showing all connected nodes
- Screenshot of both test executions in the Runs tab
- Screenshot of tickets received at webhook.site

Push your playbook export (JSON) to GitHub: **Workflows → Export**

expected_output: A working Shuffle SOAR playbook (exported as JSON on GitHub) with screenshots showing: the workflow canvas, two successful test runs (high-risk and low-risk), and the generated alert/ticket outputs.
